title: A new client, start to finish
question: I just got a new client. What do I do?
summary: From the first message to deletion: 104 steps in 7 stages, with 16 gates and 11 loops. Generated from the `Workflow Model` (`docs/workflow/`) by `bun run atlas` in `tools/workflow`; change the model, never this page.
tldr: **Open the Envelope.** A new client gets one Envelope under private/, a neutral Alias, the envelope.json every Meta File copies, and one task record named by the Alias, before any question is asked.

**Intake by Relay.** The client answers one question list, consent first, through the owner (and optionally an Intake Form beside the chat message); nothing after this stage starts before the client's "I agree" is in intake/messages.md.

**Facts, Scout, CV Decisions, Deep Dives and one follow-up.** Turn the client's answers into sourced facts, research what this client's target expects, decide what the CV must say, and ask the client once more, in one batch, for what is still missing.
**Text Draft and Sign-off.** The client checks every fact of the CV in the Text Draft before any design work starts.

**Design and build the CV.** Turn the signed-off facts into the client's CV design and its build files: the Flagship for a Domain that has it, a custom composition when the data does not fit it, or a one-off Template from an Idea Run when the Domain has no Template; every client CV's design passes the design-reviewer and the codex-visual-reviewer.

**Render, Approval, Export and delivery.** Render the CV as a Revision, check it, let the owner approve its exact bytes, export a verified copy, write the delete-by date, and record the delivery once the owner has sent it.

**Retention, deletion and closing the record.** Keep a client's data only as long as promised: name stalled clients and passed delete-by dates to the owner, honour a request to keep, have the owner erase the Envelope and its Google items, and close the client's task.

does: Reached at the cap of: Fix and render again after a failed render (placeholder cap); Fix and render again after example wording (placeholder cap); The owner's changes, as new Revisions (placeholder cap).

phases.title: Retention, deletion and closing the record

steps.title: Name stalled clients to the owner
steps.summary: The new-client skill's report to the owner
does: Only when: Every time the new-client skill runs.
in: The Envelope's README.md (Alias and intake date): `private/<envelope>/README.md`
out: Stalled clients and passed delete-by dates, by Alias

steps.title: Name passed delete-by dates to the owner
steps.summary: The new-client skill's report to the owner
does: Only when: Every time the new-client skill runs.
in: README.md, the Export and delete-by line: `private/<envelope>/README.md`
out: Stalled clients and passed delete-by dates, by Alias

steps.title: The client asks to keep his data
steps.summary: The client asks, through the owner, that his details be kept beyond 12 months after delivery.
does: Only when: The client asks to keep his data beyond the delete-by date.
in: The questions in the client's chat
out: The client's request to keep his data

steps.title: Record the keep request in envelope.json
steps.summary: Records the client's keep request as a field in envelope.json, so the delete-by check skips this client.
does: Only when: The client asked to keep his data.
in: The client's request to keep his data

steps.title: Hand the owner the history-erase commands
steps.summary: Gives the owner the guide's history-erase commands filled in with the Envelope's folder name; he runs them, the lead never does.
does: Only when: The delete-by date has passed and envelope.json records no keep request, or the owner decides to delete a client who never reached Export (no consent, dropped out).
in: Stalled clients and passed delete-by dates, by Alias

steps.title: Delete the Intake Forms, Sheets and script projects
steps.you: The owner deletes each Intake Form, its Sheet and its script project listed in README.md, then empties the Drive Trash.
does: Only when: The client had an Intake Form, and the delete-by date has passed with no keep request recorded, or the owner decides to delete a client who never reached Export (no consent, dropped out).
in: Stalled clients and passed delete-by dates, by Alias

steps.title: Delete the Envelope and erase it from the private history
steps.you: With git status and git log origin/main.. empty in private/, the owner runs the erase in a fresh clone (git filter-repo, force-push), then deletes that folder and every clone, private/ included, and clones it again.
does: Only when: The delete-by date has passed and envelope.json records no keep request, or the owner decides to delete a client who never reached Export (no consent, dropped out).
out: The private repository without the Envelope

steps.title: Close the client's task
steps.summary: Closes the client's Backlog.md task once the Envelope is deleted.
in: The private repository without the Envelope

steps.title: Remove failed or unapproved Revisions
steps.you: The owner gives his explicit go, on the exact command shown first, to remove failed or unapproved Revisions.
does: Only when: The owner wants failed or unapproved Revisions removed before the delete-by date.
